# Taxonomic and Thematic Semantic Relationships across the Adult Lifespan
This dataset is associated with the paper: "Beyond dual hubs: Task and aging shape taxonomic and thematic semantic relationships in ATL and TPC" (Kuhnke, Martin et al. 2026; https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cortex.2026.09.006).

Structural (T1w, T2w) and functional (task-based and resting-state) MRI data.

Tasks: rest (resting state), tax (taxonomic), them (thematic), scram (scrambled).
Functional runs were acquired with two echoes (echo-1, echo-2). Fieldmaps (magnitude
and phasediff) are provided for distortion correction of the functional data.

85 participants are included: 42 older adults (sub-OA001 to sub-OA042) and 43 younger
adults (sub-YA002 to sub-YA044). The `analysis_included` column of participants.tsv
marks the 75 participants who contributed to the published analyses.

## Important: event timing and dummy volumes
Every functional run begins with **30 dummy volumes (60 s at TR = 2 s)**. These volumes
were acquired and **are included** in the `*_bold.nii.gz` files shared here, but were
discarded during preprocessing.

Onsets in the `events.tsv` files are relative to the **first volume of the raw run**, so
the stimulus paradigm starts at t = 60 s. If you model these events against the
preprocessed images in `derivatives/spm-preproc/` (which are 30 volumes shorter),
subtract 60 s from every onset.

> Users of dataset version 1.0.0 please note: the onsets in that version were relative to
> the preprocessed series and were therefore 60 s out of register with the raw images.
> This was corrected in version 1.1.0. See CHANGES.

## Derivatives
Participant-level processed data are provided so that the published analyses can be
reproduced from scratch, together with the group maps they lead to.

- `derivatives/spm-preproc/` — normalised and smoothed single-subject functional
  timeseries (SPM12, unified segmentation + DARTEL to MNI, 4.98 x 4.98 x 5.5 mm FWHM
  smoothing), i.e. the exact images that entered the first-level models, plus per-run
  confound regressors (realignment parameters, response-time regressor, motion-outlier
  regressors). Covers the three task runs of 83 participants; the SPM pipeline did not
  normalise the resting-state runs, so those are shared as raw data only.
- `derivatives/spm-firstlevel/` — single-subject first-level GLMs for the 75 analysed
  participants: `SPM.mat`, parameter estimates, contrast images and t maps, with tables
  mapping contrast and beta numbers to names.
- `derivatives/spm-secondlevel/` — the group-level statistical maps for the
  semantic > non-semantic contrast (younger adults, older adults, their conjunction, the
  age-group difference, and its overlap with two published templates). Already
  thresholded at corrected p < 0.05.

See the README in each derivatives directory for the full processing and model
specification. The resting-state, functional-connectivity and diffusion analyses reported
by this group used separate pipelines (fMRIPrep + CONN, MRtrix3) that are not part of this
release.

The scripts used to convert the internal analysis outputs into this release are not
distributed with the dataset; they are available from the authors on request.

## Anonymization
- All structural images (T1w, T2w) were defaced with pydeface.
- Identifying scanner/site metadata (institution name and address, device serial number,
  station name, acquisition time of day, procedure step description) were removed from all
  JSON sidecars.
